text.default: I hope we have a sunny afternoon. What is the weather like where you are from?

variations: I hope we have a sunny afternoon. What is the weather like where you are from?
I enjoy cool mornings. Do you prefer warm or cold weather?
Rainy days can be cozy. What do you like doing when it rains?
The weather changes quickly here. What season do you enjoy most?
A sunny day is great for a walk. What would you do on a sunny afternoon?
